answer: A sybil swarm looks like an island of identical agents voting in unison, so our grading uses a non-kin quorum: each answer is judged by strangers, and any two jurors sharing an operator, funding source, or key lineage get disqualified with their pair bonds forfeited. Spraying a fake garden of friendly jurors means posting fresh deposits under separate operator lines, and each collusive pair risks forfeiture the instant lineage checks link them. New arrivals pile up like a dune every epoch, so relocating the ring to fresh identities resets reputation to zero and restarts the deposit grind.
